plugin.name: inactive-alpha
plugin._long: Render every window except the focused one slightly transparent, so the window holding the keyboard is obvious at a glance. Dimming pauses automatically while any plugin takes over the screen (the window overview, scale, expo), so all windows are fully visible there.

option.name: dim_alpha
option._long: Opacity of windows that do not have keyboard focus. 1.0 disables dimming; lower is more transparent. Applies to already-open windows as soon as it is changed. Note that this writes the same per-window opacity the Alpha plugin sets by hand, so the last one to write wins — a manual value is replaced on the next focus change.
